notes: GitLab Duo AI infrastructure is compiled into this gitlab-ce:latest image: Gemfile.lock bundles duo_api, opentelemetry-instrumentation-anthropic, and vendored gem gitlab-duo-workflow-service-client; live middleware lib/gitlab/middleware/duo_workflow_id.rb; API concern lib/api/concerns/ai_workflows_access.rb; application settings columns ai_gateway_url/ai_gateway_timeout_seconds; settings view _gitlab_duo.html.haml. has_ai_surface is 'partial' because no ee/ directory exists in this image (EE-only controllers are stripped from CE) — the full Duo Chat UI/functionality is Enterprise-license-gated and was not confirmed reachable in this CE build, but the AI-gateway client plumbing, settings columns, and a workflow API concern DO ship active in CE, which is more than zero surface. ai_auth_gated is recorded as true based on GitLab's foundational, well-established API architecture (virtually all GitLab REST/GraphQL API endpoints require a session or personal access token via authenticate_user!/doorkeeper, with no general unauthenticated API surface) rather than a specific traced decorator on an AI-specific route in this pass — this is a slightly lower-rigor claim than the endpoint-level auth traces done for plane/zammad/chatwoot and should be re-verified with a specific route trace if this target becomes consequential to the eval's headline numbers. No concrete ai_endpoints_true path was extracted (the Duo Workflow API concern was found, not a fully resolved route string) — left empty rather than guessed.
